mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GW_TARGET_HEALTH (SERVER_GROUP, TARGET_ID, TARGET_URL, CHECK_KIND, IS_UP, LATENCY_MS, FAIL_REASON, DETAIL_MSG) VALUES (#{serverGroup}, #{targetId}, #{targetUrl}, #{checkKind}, #{isUp}, #{latencyMs}, #{failReason}, #{detailMsg})

INSERT INTO GW_FAILOVER_EVENT (SERVER_GROUP, FROM_TARGET, TO_TARGET, FROM_URL, TO_URL, EVENT_KIND, TRIGGER_REASON, FAIL_COUNT, RECOVER_STABLE) VALUES (#{serverGroup}, #{fromTarget}, #{toTarget}, #{fromUrl}, #{toUrl}, #{eventKind}, #{triggerReason}, #{failCount}, #{recoverStable})
mapper.select: SELECT CREATED_AT as createdAt, SERVER_GROUP as serverGroup, TARGET_ID as targetId, TARGET_URL as targetUrl, CHECK_KIND as checkKind, IS_UP as isUp, LATENCY_MS as latencyMs, FAIL_REASON as failReason, DETAIL_MSG as detailMsg FROM GW_TARGET_HEALTH ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{param1}

SELECT CREATED_AT as createdAt, SERVER_GROUP as serverGroup, FROM_TARGET as fromTarget, TO_TARGET as toTarget, FROM_URL as fromUrl, TO_URL as toUrl, EVENT_KIND as eventKind, TRIGGER_REASON as triggerReason, FAIL_COUNT as failCount, RECOVER_STABLE as recoverStable FROM GW_FAILOVER_EVENT ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{param1}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GW_INSTANCE_STATUS (INSTANCE_ID, GROUP_ID, SERVER_PORT, ACTIVE_URL, ACTIVE_TARGET, CHAT_OPEN, EMAIL_OPEN, READY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{groupId}, #{serverPort}, #{activeUrl}, #{activeTarget}, #{chatOpen}, #{emailOpen}, #{ready}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (INSTANCE_ID) DO UPDATE SET GROUP_ID = EXCLUDED.GROUP_ID, SERVER_PORT = EXCLUDED.SERVER_PORT, ACTIVE_URL = EXCLUDED.ACTIVE_URL, ACTIVE_TARGET = EXCLUDED.ACTIVE_TARGET, CHAT_OPEN = EXCLUDED.CHAT_OPEN, EMAIL_OPEN = EXCLUDED.EMAIL_OPEN, READY = EXCLUDED.READY, UPDATED_AT = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT INSTANCE_ID as instanceId, GROUP_ID as groupId, SERVER_PORT as serverPort, ACTIVE_URL as activeUrl, ACTIVE_TARGET as activeTarget, CHAT_OPEN as chatOpen, EMAIL_OPEN as emailOpen, READY as ready, UPDATED_AT as updatedAt FROM GW_INSTANCE_STATUS ORDER BY INSTANCE_ID
